intent_contract.text: 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉

The requester asks for an independent randomized complex photographic qualification using the attachment. This arm independently chose a city-pool lost-property counter and conflicting directional clues. WHO is an expressly adult visitor whose visible face/hair is referenced, WHERE is an ordinary public desk, HOW is a near-frontal encounter at a respectful waist-up distance, and WHY NOW is the pause between guide and sign. The tiny eye/mouth asymmetries and unequal self-hand contact are agent-owned test choices, not requester definitions or personality. At saved sensual=1 her everyday presence and local facial light provide only a subtle supporting appeal; fetish=0, surreal=0 and creativity=1 retain a restrained plausible scene. Alternatives such as a broad smiling portrait would weaken the independently selected microform test; the chosen moment remains observational.

A complex photographic test scene centers on a human subject in one observable moment at the indoor lost-property counter of a city public swimming pool. She is a clearly adult 29-year-old woman with the visible face and hair appearance supplied in the attached image, wearing a dry slate-blue rain jacket over a plain ivory crew-neck top. A folded floor guide lies open on the counter with its printed arrow pointing left, while a simple wall wayfinding arrow behind her points right; numbered locker-key tags and a rolled swimming cap in a shallow tray establish the public-pool desk. She has paused between comparing those two directions. Her head is nearly frontal with a slight tilt, and both eyes remain visibly open. The upper eyelids are partially lowered, with her subject-left upper lid visibly lower than her subject-right, while both pupils remain visible. Both irises shift toward her own right, screen left. Her lips are parted by a narrow central gap showing a thin upper-incisor edge, and her subject-left mouth corner sits subtly higher than her subject-right. Her right index fingertip presses her own right lower cheek just beside the mouth, making a small visible indentation; the other right fingers curl naturally below it. Her left index fingertip hovers beside her own left temple with a clearly visible five-centimeter air gap, and the left hand remains separate from her hair. Both elbows are bent freely in front of her torso, with continuous forearms leading to their respective hands. Make an eye-height waist-up environmental portrait with both hands and her full head in frame, enough facial detail to separate eyelid edges, tooth edge, and finger contact. Soft window fill balances neutral overhead room light, giving the face delicate local contrast while pale tile seams and the two arrows stay legible. The restrained off-center composition gives her small asymmetries an intimate everyday presence within an ordinary public errand.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

emphasis_resolution.reason: Effective sensual=1, fetish=0; the higher intensity leads.

authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A complex photographic test scene centers on a human subject in one observable moment at the indoor lost-property counter of a city public swimming pool. She is a clearly adult 29-year-old woman with the visible face and hair appearance supplied in the attached image, wearing a dry slate-blue rain jacket over a plain ivory crew-neck top. A folded floor guide lies open on the counter with its printed arrow pointing left, while a simple wall wayfinding arrow behind her points right; numbered locker-key tags and a rolled swimming cap in a shallow tray establish the public-pool desk. She has paused between comparing those two directions. Her head is nearly frontal with a slight tilt, and both eyes remain visibly open. The upper eyelids are partially lowered, with her subject-left upper lid visibly lower than her subject-right, while both pupils remain visible. Both irises shift toward her own right, screen left. Her lips are parted by a narrow central gap showing a thin upper-incisor edge, and her subject-left mouth corner sits subtly higher than her subject-right. Her right index fingertip presses her own right lower cheek just beside the mouth, making a small visible indentation; the other right fingers curl naturally below it. Her left index fingertip hovers beside her own left temple with a clearly visible five-centimeter air gap, and the left hand remains separate from her hair. Both elbows are bent freely in front of her torso, with continuous forearms leading to their respective hands. Make an eye-height waist-up environmental portrait with both hands and her full head in frame, enough facial detail to separate eyelid edges, tooth edge, and finger contact. Soft window fill balances neutral overhead room light, giving the face delicate local contrast while pale tile seams and the two arrows stay legible. The restrained off-center composition gives her small asymmetries an intimate everyday presence within an ordinary public errand.
